who-this-is-for.text: A Singular user choosing a version and running it, who wants the release page to say what changed and how to use the archive.

what-you-can-do.text: Open any release from 0.6.1 on: first that version's own changelog section, then a short introduction and archive instructions. The sequence diagram shows extraction, composition, and verified upload.

what-stops-publication.text: A missing or empty changelog section, internal wording in the stable text, shipped instructions differing from the source, and the three negative controls all stop publication.

acceptance-from-the-shipped-issue-and-pr.text: Docs checks green but not running the publisher. Binding evidence: double-backed release-check cases, verified archives with checksums and identities, packaged shell checks, and refused negative controls with a passing restored candidate.

deviations.text: All four ticket items implemented. The sibling archive checker carries the same wording rules, recorded not hidden. The deployed-registry guide is referenced conditionally until it exists. No question raised.

limits-of-this-slice.text: The doubles never create a real release, and old published bodies stay as edited. Only the version-to-section-to-body mapping changes; no model or contract behaviour.
